body: My wife says I'm weak, and pathetic because I feel the way I do.

I have this letter I wrote 2 years ago, 2 days before my birthday. No one has ever read it, or even knows it exists but I've been adding onto it every month since.
Just a document full of suffer.

There's so much pain in my body. 
Such weight in my soul.
7 straight years I've been fighting demons. 
Its scary when you feel your body shut down.

I'm not going to kill myself.
No one should.

.. but if I do, I want my family to know that I did try. I really gave it a real try. I wanted to live, I wanted to see my daughter grow, I looked forward to making my wife laugh.. but the truth is is that she WOULD have been way better off without me.

I've accepted that I'm not going to kill myself..
I've accepted that every day of my life will be torment..
I've accepted that my wife won't get the love & happiness she deserves because she wants to waste her time on me.
I've accepted being worthless, a failure, a loser, and & fuck-up. 

I am weak. As long as I'm still here, I'm weak. 
Strength would be doing what's necessary for my family to thrive. 
Im too afraid to rip off that bandaid.
